scenes.text: Candy corn was first sold as chicken feed.
It dates back to the eighteen eighties, in Philadelphia.
A candymaker named George Renninger is usually credited with inventing it.
It was sold as Chicken Feed, in a box with a rooster on the front.
Back then, every batch of kernels was made by hand.
It only became a Halloween icon after trick or treating took off in the late nineteen forties.
So, candy corn: love it or hate it?

title: Candy corn was first sold as chicken feed 🐔
caption: Candy corn dates back to the 1880s and was marketed as "Chicken Feed" in a box with a rooster on it. It only became a Halloween staple once trick-or-treating boomed in the late 1940s. 🎃
